title: 高亮度 X 光束線~High-brilliance X-ray beamlines
focus: 從波盪器光源到樣品的相空間保存、掠射鏡、熱負載、斜率誤差、穩定度與 KB 奈米聚焦~Phase-space preservation, grazing mirrors, heat load, slope error, stability and KB nanofocusing from undulator source to sample
summary: 以 3 GeV 儲存環上的波盪器硬 X 光束線為例，說明光束線為何只能保存而不能增加亮度，並把掠射全反射鏡、前端熱負載、鏡面斜率誤差與量測、光束位置穩定度、Kirkpatrick–Baez 聚焦與通量校正串成一份可驗收的光束線工程紀錄。~Using an undulator hard X-ray beamline on a 3 GeV storage ring, the course shows why a beamline can only preserve and never increase brilliance, then links grazing-incidence mirrors, front-end heat load, mirror slope error and its metrology, beam-position stability, Kirkpatrick–Baez focusing and flux calibration into an acceptance-ready beamline engineering record.

units.anchor: 波盪器光源點與相空間~Undulator source point and phase space
units.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度~Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance
units.mechanism: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。依 Liouville 定理，被動光學元件只能重新分配相空間而不能壓縮它：鏡子可以把光斑縮小，但發散角必然等比放大，任何像差、散射、振動或不匹配的孔徑都只會損失亮度。因此光束線設計的核心是讓每個元件的接收度與光源相空間匹配，並把亮度損失分配到可量化的項目。~Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. By Liouville's theorem passive optics can only redistribute phase space, never compress it: a mirror can shrink the spot but the divergence grows in proportion, and every aberration, scatter, vibration or mismatched aperture can only lose brilliance. The core of beamline design is therefore to match each element's acceptance to the source phase space and assign brilliance losses to quantifiable items.
units.model: 光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。若電子束 ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad、ε_y = 16 pm·rad（假設 1% 耦合），各平面同調分率 ε_r/(ε + ε_r) 為 0.49% 與 33%，總同調分率約 0.16%，水平方向是瓶頸。~The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å). For electron emittances ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad and ε_y = 16 pm·rad (1% coupling assumed), the per-plane coherent fraction ε_r/(ε + ε_r) is 0.49% and 33%, giving about 0.16% overall, with the horizontal plane as the bottleneck.
units.verify: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。~Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction.
units.failure: 鏡子長度或狹縫開口與光源相空間不匹配時，邊緣光被截斷或帶著像差進入聚焦，樣品處通量與同調度同時低於預期，而每個元件單獨檢查都顯示合格。~When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check.
units.misconception: 加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。~Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.

units.anchor: 掠射鏡塗層條帶~Grazing-mirror coating stripes
units.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止~Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off
units.mechanism: X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。臨界角 θc = √(2δ)，而 δ 與材料電子密度及波長平方成正比，所以高密度塗層（Rh、Pt）能在較大角度或較高能量下反射，矽則較早截止。光束線利用這個能量截止：選擇塗層條帶與掠射角，讓所需能量完整反射，而單色器同時通過的三倍、五倍高次諧波被濾掉。~At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected. The critical angle is θc = √(2δ), and δ scales with the material's electron density and with wavelength squared, so dense coatings such as Rh or Pt reflect at larger angles or higher energies while silicon cuts off earlier. Beamlines exploit this cut-off: choosing the coating stripe and grazing angle passes the wanted energy fully while rejecting the third and fifth harmonics that the monochromator also transmits.
units.model: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。掠射角 3 mrad 時，Si 條帶約在 10.4 keV 截止、Rh 條帶約在 22 keV 截止；要在 8 keV 工作並抑制 24 keV 的三次諧波，應選 Si 條帶或把 Rh 條帶角度提高到約 3.5 mrad 以上。~δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. At 3 mrad grazing the Si stripe cuts off near 10.4 keV and the Rh stripe near 22 keV; to work at 8 keV while rejecting the 24 keV third harmonic, use the Si stripe or raise a Rh stripe above about 3.5 mrad.
units.verify: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。~Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector.
units.failure: 把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。~Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis.
units.misconception: X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。~X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.

units.anchor: 前端遮罩與第一面鏡~Front-end masks and first mirror
units.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載~Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load
units.mechanism: 波盪器送出的總功率是千瓦級，但實驗需要的單色光子功率只有毫瓦到瓦級，所以光束線前段的任務是安全地把多餘功率丟掉。前端區以水冷銅合金固定遮罩與可動狹縫限制角度範圍，濾片與第一面鏡進一步吸收低能與高能部分。第一個承受白光的光學元件會因局部溫度梯度產生熱鼓包，改變斜率與焦距；材料以 α/k（熱膨脹係數除以熱導率）衡量，矽冷卻到約 125 K 時熱膨脹係數趨近零，是高功率密度元件的常見解法。~An undulator delivers kilowatts of total power while the experiment needs only milliwatts to watts of monochromatic photons, so the front of the beamline must dump the excess safely. The front end limits the angular range with water-cooled copper-alloy fixed masks and movable slits, and filters and the first mirror absorb further low- and high-energy power. The first optic to see white beam develops a thermal bump from local temperature gradients that alters slope and focal length; materials are ranked by α/k, expansion coefficient over conductivity, and silicon cooled to about 125 K, where its expansion coefficient approaches zero, is the usual answer for high power density.
units.model: 總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]。E = 3 GeV、λu = 22 mm、K = 1.5（B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T）、L = 3 m、I = 0.5 A，P ≈ 4.6 kW；而 12.8 keV（第 7 諧波）處 10¹⁴ ph/s 的光只攜帶約 0.2 W。α/k：室溫矽 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W，Glidcop ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W，室溫矽的熱變形約只有銅合金的四成。~Total power is P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]. For E = 3 GeV, λu = 22 mm, K = 1.5 (B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T), L = 3 m and I = 0.5 A, P ≈ 4.6 kW, while 10¹⁴ ph/s at 12.8 keV (seventh harmonic) carries only about 0.2 W. α/k is ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W for room-temperature silicon and ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W for Glidcop, so room-temperature silicon distorts only about 40% as much as the copper alloy.
units.verify: 以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化；運轉時比較冷卻水量熱、元件熱電偶讀值與預測值，並在不同間隙與電流下量測焦點位置漂移，驗證熱變形模型。~Compute absorbed power on each mask, filter and mirror with a power-density code and feed it into finite-element thermal-structural analysis to obtain the surface slope change; in operation compare water calorimetry and thermocouple readings with prediction, and measure focal-position drift at different gaps and currents to validate the thermal-deformation model.
units.failure: 閉合波盪器間隙或提高儲存電流後，第一面鏡的熱鼓包使焦點沿光軸移動並放大光斑，使用者看到通量隨時間與間隙變化；若遮罩接收角估錯，射線直接照到未冷卻的法蘭，造成真空洩漏。~After closing the undulator gap or raising stored current, the thermal bump on the first mirror shifts the focus along the axis and enlarges the spot, so users see flux vary with time and gap; if a mask acceptance angle is wrong, radiation strikes an uncooled flange and causes a vacuum leak.
units.misconception: 光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。~A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.

units.anchor: 單晶矽鏡體與拋光面~Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface
units.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造~Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication
units.mechanism: 掠射鏡長達數百毫米，因為掠射角只有毫弧度，光斑在鏡面上被拉長數百倍。鏡面誤差依空間尺度分成兩類：毫米到全長尺度的斜率誤差使反射光偏折兩倍，在焦點處加寬光斑；微米以下的高頻粗糙度則把光散射出鏡面反射方向，降低反射率。現代鏡體以單晶矽製作，經確定性拋光、離子束修形或彈性發射加工把斜率誤差壓到 0.1 µrad 甚至 50 nrad 均方根以下。~Grazing mirrors are hundreds of millimetres long because a milliradian grazing angle stretches the footprint hundreds of times. Surface errors fall into two classes by length scale: slope errors from millimetres to full length deflect the reflected ray by twice the error and broaden the focus, while sub-micrometre roughness scatters light out of the specular direction and lowers reflectivity. Modern blanks are single-crystal silicon brought to 0.1 µrad or even below 50 nrad RMS slope error by deterministic polishing, ion-beam figuring or elastic emission machining.
units.model: 斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。粗糙度造成的反射率損失 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]：σ = 0.3 nm、θ = 3 mrad、λ = 1 Å 時約 1.3%，σ = 1 nm 時升到約 13%。~Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM). Roughness costs reflectivity 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]: about 1.3% for σ = 0.3 nm, θ = 3 mrad and λ = 1 Å, rising to about 13% for σ = 1 nm.
units.verify: 製造過程中交替使用斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀量測，依每次量測的殘差規劃下一次修形停留時間；粗糙度以白光干涉與 AFM 在不同取樣長度量測並合成功率譜密度，確認各頻段 σ 都在預算內，再把量到的表面高度圖代入波前傳播模擬預測焦斑。~During fabrication alternate slope profilometry and stitching interferometry, planning each figuring dwell map from the previous residual; measure roughness with white-light interferometry and AFM at several sampling lengths, merge them into a power spectral density, confirm each band's σ is in budget, and propagate the measured height map through a wavefront simulation to predict the focus.
units.failure: 只要求全長 PV 高度而沒有規定斜率誤差與中頻譜段時，鏡面可能高度合格卻帶有數毫米週期的波紋，在焦點兩側產生衛星峰並破壞相干成像的條紋對比。~Specifying only full-length PV height without slope error and mid-frequency bands can yield a mirror that passes height yet carries millimetre-period ripple, creating satellite peaks beside the focus and destroying fringe contrast in coherent imaging.
units.misconception: 掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。~Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor.

units.anchor: 斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉~Slope profiler and stitching interferometry
units.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證~Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation
units.mechanism: 鏡面斜率誤差小到 50 nrad 時，量測本身成為瓶頸：長程輪廓儀與奈米光學量測機以自準直儀或筆形光束量測斜率並積分成高度，拼接干涉儀則把多個子孔徑拼成全長高度圖。兩種方法的系統誤差來源不同，交叉比對才可信。鏡子裝上彎曲機構或冷卻夾具後形狀還會改變，因此最後要在光束線上以刀口掃描、斑點追蹤或光柵干涉直接量測 X 光波前，把離線數據與線上表現連起來。~When slope errors reach 50 nrad, metrology itself becomes the bottleneck: long trace profilers and nanometre optical component measuring machines measure slope with autocollimators or pencil beams and integrate it into height, while stitching interferometers combine sub-apertures into a full-length height map. The two have different systematic errors and must be cross-checked to be trusted. Mounting on a bender or cooled holder changes the shape again, so the final step measures the X-ray wavefront on the beamline by knife-edge scans, speckle tracking or grating interferometry, linking ex-situ data to in-situ performance.
units.model: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。L = 300 mm、Δs = 0.5 µrad 時 Δh ≈ 18.8 nm。若規格是 0.15 µrad rms，量測不確定度應低於其三分之一，約 50 nrad rms。~For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. With L = 300 mm and Δs = 0.5 µrad, Δh ≈ 18.8 nm. If the specification is 0.15 µrad rms, measurement uncertainty should be below a third of it, about 50 nrad rms.
units.verify: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。~Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%.
units.failure: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。~A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause.
units.misconception: 斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。~The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline.

units.anchor: X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰~X-ray BPM and mirror pitch
units.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算~Beam-position stability and the vibration budget
units.mechanism: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。一般要求光斑位置的穩定度優於光斑尺寸的 10%。光束線用刀片式或鑽石四象限 X 光束位置監測器量測光束位置，再以壓電致動器回授鏡面或單色器角度；振動來源包括地板、冷卻水流、液氮沸騰與真空幫浦，必須用預算表逐項分配。~A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The usual requirement is spot-position stability better than 10% of the spot size. Beamlines measure position with blade-type or diamond quadrant X-ray beam-position monitors and feed back to mirror or monochromator angles with piezo actuators; vibration sources include the floor, cooling-water flow, liquid-nitrogen boiling and vacuum pumps, and each must be allocated in a budget table.
units.model: KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。距光源 30 m 的上游平面鏡俯仰 50 nrad 使虛光源移動 2δ×30 m = 3 µm，經縮小倍率 M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 後只移動 15 nm；對 100 nm 光斑，KB 的俯仰穩定度需優於約 17 nrad。~A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. A 50 nrad pitch on an upstream flat mirror 30 m from the source moves the virtual source by 2δ×30 m = 3 µm, which the demagnification M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 reduces to 15 nm; for a 100 nm spot the KB pitch must be stable to better than about 17 nrad.
units.verify: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。~Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor.
units.failure: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。~Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam.
units.misconception: 離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。~The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.

units.anchor: KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫~KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit
units.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源~KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source
units.mechanism: Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。焦斑由三項決定：光源大小乘以縮小倍率 q/p、鏡面孔徑造成的繞射極限、以及斜率誤差與振動。水平發射度大時，常在中段放置次級光源狹縫，把縮小倍率作用在狹縫開口上，以通量換取更小的光斑與更高的同調度。~A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range. The spot is set by three terms: source size times the demagnification q/p, the diffraction limit from the mirror aperture, and slope error plus vibration. When horizontal emittance is large, a secondary-source slit is placed mid-beamline so the demagnification acts on the slit opening, trading flux for a smaller spot and higher coherence.
units.model: 鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。水平以 20 µm 次級狹縫、距 KB 30 m、q = 0.3 m，幾何像約 0.2 µm。~With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature. Horizontally a 20 µm secondary slit 30 m upstream with q = 0.3 m images to about 0.2 µm.
units.verify: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。~After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point.
units.failure: 兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。~If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it.
units.misconception: 只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。~With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.

units.anchor: 光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄~Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record
units.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接~Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff
units.mechanism: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。通量通常用已知厚度的矽光二極體量測，光子在矽中每產生一對電子電洞平均需約 3.66 eV，再修正吸收比例；同時要與光源計算值比較，找出傳輸損失落在哪個元件。輻射屏蔽實驗站與聯鎖系統的驗證由輻射安全單位依法規執行，屬於交接文件的必要部分。~Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. Flux is usually measured with a silicon photodiode of known thickness, where each electron–hole pair costs about 3.66 eV on average, corrected for the absorbed fraction, and compared with the source calculation to locate where transmission is lost. Verification of the shielded hutch and its interlocks is performed by the radiation-safety group under regulation and is a required part of the handoff record.
units.model: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。光二極體電流 I = 0.5 mA、w = 3.66 eV、E = 12.4 keV、300 µm 矽在此能量的吸收比 η ≈ 0.70 時，N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s；若光源計算在同頻寬給出 3×10¹² ph/s，光束線傳輸約 44%。~Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). With photodiode current I = 0.5 mA, w = 3.66 eV, E = 12.4 keV and an absorbed fraction η ≈ 0.70 for 300 µm silicon at this energy, N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s; if the source calculation predicts 3×10¹² ph/s in the same bandwidth, beamline transmission is about 44%.
units.verify: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。~Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report.
units.failure: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。~Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up.
units.misconception: 光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。~Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.

example: KB 奈米聚焦預算練習：E = 15 keV（λ ≈ 0.827 Å），垂直 KB 鏡長 L = 0.12 m、掠射角 θ = 3.5 mrad（低於 Rh 在 15 keV 的臨界角約 4.5 mrad），p = 50 m、q = 0.12 m。孔徑 A = L·θ = 0.42 mm，NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³，繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm；光源垂直 FWHM 12 µm 乘以 M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ 得 28.8 nm；斜率誤差 50 nrad rms 貢獻 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm；鏡面俯仰振動 10 nrad rms 貢獻約 5.7 nm。平方和 √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM。兩面 Rh 鏡各以反射率 0.85 計，傳輸約 72%。若斜率誤差放寬到 0.1 µrad，該項變為 56.5 nm，總光斑約 67 nm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際光束線規格。~KB nanofocus budget exercise: E = 15 keV (λ ≈ 0.827 Å), vertical KB mirror length L = 0.12 m, grazing angle θ = 3.5 mrad (below the Rh critical angle of about 4.5 mrad at 15 keV), p = 50 m and q = 0.12 m. The aperture is A = L·θ = 0.42 mm, NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm; a 12 µm FWHM vertical source times M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ gives 28.8 nm; 50 nrad rms slope error contributes 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm; 10 nrad rms pitch vibration adds about 5.7 nm. The quadrature sum √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM. Taking reflectivity 0.85 for each of the two Rh mirrors, transmission is about 72%. Relaxing slope error to 0.1 µrad makes that term 56.5 nm and the total spot about 67 nm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real beamline specification.
history: 1948 年 Kirkpatrick 與 Baez 提出以兩面正交掠射鏡做 X 光成像，因當時鏡面加工精度不足而長期只是原理；1990 年代以波盪器為主的第三代同步輻射光源（ESRF、APS、SPring-8）讓亮度躍升數個數量級，鏡面斜率誤差與熱負載才成為光束線工程的核心課題，日本與歐美團隊也在 2000 年代把 KB 鏡推進到奈米聚焦。台灣光子源 TPS 為 3 GeV、發射度約 1.6 nm·rad 的儲存環，2014 年底首次出光，其蛋白質結晶學光束線即採用波盪器與 KB 聚焦。~In 1948 Kirkpatrick and Baez proposed X-ray imaging with two orthogonal grazing mirrors, an idea that stayed largely theoretical because mirror fabrication was not precise enough; third-generation undulator sources of the 1990s such as ESRF, APS and SPring-8 raised brilliance by orders of magnitude and made slope error and heat load central to beamline engineering, and Japanese, European and US teams pushed KB mirrors to nanofocusing in the 2000s. The Taiwan Photon Source is a 3 GeV ring with about 1.6 nm·rad emittance that saw first light at the end of 2014, and its protein-crystallography beamlines use undulators with KB focusing.
